verdict.rationale: The providers docs say OpenClaw can use many LLM providers configured as `provider/model`, and one community user reports running OpenClaw with local models inside a NixOS VM. That suggests local-model operation is possible, but no first-party evidence names Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM, or confirms a fully cloud-free setup. Missing for 10: documented support for Ollama/llama.cpp/LM Studio/vLLM backends, confirmation that no cloud model dependency remains (e.g. onboarding or auxiliary features), and in-depth local-model setup docs.
